request: flashcards for learning english words, flip to see the meaning, mark known or again

checklist.item: can add a card with word and meaning
shows one card at a time with a flip to reveal meaning
buttons to mark known or again
shows known count
next card button

program:
app "Flashcards" cards plum
table flash word text, meaning text, known bool
state i num = 0
state flipped bool = no
each flash sort at as c
  if index = i
    stack card gap 2 pad 4 align center tap set flipped = not flipped
      if flipped
        c.meaning big
      else
        c.word big
row gap 1
  button "Previous" tap set i = clamp(i - 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
  button "Next" tap set i = clamp(i + 1, 0, count(flash) - 1) then set flipped = no
i + 1 "of" count(flash) faint
form flash, "Add card"
describe:
Flashcards, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- flash: word: text; meaning: text; known: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: i, starting at 0; flipped, starting at no.
Shows:
- for each flash sorted by at:
  - if its position is i:
    - a group; a tap sets flipped to not flipped:
      - if flipped:
        - text: the meaning of the flash.
      - otherwise:
        - text: the word of the flash.
